ns2:course.label: Singing in Musical Theatre
ns2:course.description: This is a highly participatory class appropriate for all levels of singing experience and ability, and includes a final cabaret-style performance at the end of the semester to showcase in-class learning. Methods of instruction include vocal exercises, group somatic and vocal work, song memorization, and in-class performances. May be repeated in separate terms up to 4 hours. Prerequisite: Instructor approval required.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated in separate terms up to 4 hours. Prerequisite: Instructor approval required.
